supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The supraorbital torus exhibits a significant lateral extension beyond the outer canthus of the eye, forming a prominent shelf.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: There is a high intensity contrast between the dark-pigmented periocular and mid-facial regions and the much lighter, grey-white appearance of the lower muzzle and chin area.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits a significant 2D vertical thickness with a pronounced horizontal protrusion and visible structural droop in the neutral state.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive presence of white/grey terminal hair on the mental region (chin) and lower labial boundary.
